outcome: transforming growth factor b (TGFb) proteins at the placental invasion site
cohort: Women with histologically confirmed normal and abnormal placentation from Yale-New Haven Hospital.
finding: Angiogenic and growth factors at the placental invasion site are altered in placenta accreta, both by decidual absence and within myometrial scar, which is postulated to promote the invasive phenotype by activating hyperinvasive trophoblast and dysregulating placental vascular remodelling.
cross-section timing: During pregnancy or at delivery, when placental invasion site tissue and maternal serum samples were collected for analysis of placentation status.
